decoy.cli.compile_explain::compile::comp.reason: `validate compile --no-profile` is the single-layer command the gate's compile layer reuses helpers from; it keeps its own compile call and its unique-column error.

decoy.cli.preflight::preflight::prefligh.reason: The `validate preflight` command body is the third copy of steps 1-3 and calls the layer checks itself until CONFIG-EXPLICIT C2 folds it onto the gate.

decoy.cli.preflight::preflight::run_conf.reason: The same third copy of steps 1-3 also runs the config-only checks itself until CONFIG-EXPLICIT C2 folds it onto the gate.
